content:
sara: Heads-up: rolling models-api v2.3 tonight 2024-12-10 22:00 UTC. Need rollback/runbook sign-off by 21:30 UTC. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/models-api-rollback. Who's owning rollback & who will trigger?

alex: I'll own the rollback trigger and the escape hatch. Mike will run the post-rollback smoke. Proposed rollback criteria: sustained error rate >5% for 5min OR p95 latency >1.5s sustained for 5min. Sound good? :thinking_face:

jia: Agree with criteria. Canary plan: 10% traffic for 15m, health checks every 1m. If canary fails, immediate fallback to v2.2 (previous stable). We should document the exact failure signals in the runbook.

mike: I have production kube creds. Rollback command (prod example):
```bash
kubectl rollout undo deployment/models-api -n prod --to-revision=42
```
After rollback we should run cache invalidation. Who has Fastly creds?

alex: I have Fastly keys and will run the purge if needed. Purge example:
```bash
curl -X PURGE "https://edge.redwood.ai/models/*" -H "Fastly-Key: $FASTLY_KEY"
```
Also note: post-rollback verification steps below.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled at 2024-12-10T22:00:00Z. Canary window: 22:00-22:15Z. Alerting: pager fires on SLO breaches (error_rate_app > 0.05 OR latency_p95 > 1500ms over 5m). Logging stream will be attached to the thread.

jia: Quick runbook checklist (validate before go):
- Owner assigned and reachable (alex)
- Rollback command tested in staging
- Cache purge ready (alex)
- Post-rollback smoke script available (mike)
- On-call notified (#oncall)

sara: Post-rollback smoke check (example):
```bash
curl -sSf -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/health | jq '.status'
```
Expect: "ok" and HTTP 200 within 30s. Also spot-check /generate and /embed endpoints with sample prompts.

mike: I'll be on standby 21:45-22:30 UTC. Alex ping me at 22:00 when the canary kicks off and again if you need me to run the smoke. :thumbsup:

alex: Will do. I'll post a go/no-go at 21:25 UTC with final checks (traffic policies, canary hook, metrics dashboards up). If I don't post by 21:30, treat as hold and we delay until manual confirmation.

sara: Locking this in. If anyone spots a missing step, call it out now. Otherwise we'll proceed with the plan and follow the runbook. (cc @oncall)
